normative_extracts.quote: A nested grid container whose grid-template-columns or grid-template-rows is subgrid adopts the tracks of its parent grid along that axis.

browser_support.notes: Baseline Newly Available across Chromium, Firefox, and Safari.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Items inside a subgrid contribute their intrinsic sizes directly to the parent grid’s track-sizing pass.

production_failures.symptom: Card content overlaps or stacks into row 1 when grid-template-rows: subgrid is applied
production_failures.root_cause: The subgrid item only spans 1 parent row (default grid-row: auto) instead of spanning the number of internal rows.
production_failures.mitigation: Set grid-row: span 3 (matching header, body, footer) on the card so it claims 3 parent tracks.

production_failures.symptom: Subgrid inherits an unwanted huge gap from the parent grid
production_failures.root_cause: Subgrids inherit the parent’s gap by default unless explicitly overridden.
production_failures.mitigation: Declare row-gap: 0.5rem directly on the subgrid element to override the parent gap.
